first_affected_phase: contract measurement for escaped markup containing smart quotes

evidence.vanilla:
op(
  text: sequence(
    [a],
    [ ],
    [#],
    [ ],
    smartquote(double: true),
    [quote],
    smartquote(double: true),
  ),
  limits: false,
)

cause: The crystalline eval markup phase resolves SyntaxKind::SmartQuote into Content::Text glyphs before repr. Literal curly text and resolved smart quotes are therefore indistinguishable inside repr.rs; reconstructing provenance from glyphs would be lossy specialization.
required_restart: Revise the contract/probe to cover escaping without destroyed provenance, retain pre-resolved smartquote provenance as Unknown, then regenerate oracle/adversarial artifacts, rerun the discriminatory gate and issue a new seal.
prohibited_shortcut: Do not change another owner or the eval/layout phase under P1290, and do not infer SmartQuote from curly quote glyphs.
